full_judgment: 2. The suit was filed stating, inter alia, that by the deed of gift dated April 17, 1936 Narmada Kumari Ghose got the land in suit and she settled the same to Dinesh Chandra, father of the plaintiffs on 8th Bhadra, 1345 B.S., that on the basis of settlement Dinesh Chandra possessed the land in suit for more than 12 years and after his death plaintiffs as heirs possessing the land, that the land in suit was wrongly recorded in the name of the Government and about the said fact plaintiffs came to know in the last part of March, 1983 when they went to pay rent, that against the preparation of wrong record of right plaintiffs filed Other Suit No. 534 of 1983 and the same was decreed on January 11, 1984, that plaintiffs sold .02 acre of land from the eastern part of plot No. 10161 to the defendant Nos. 3,4 and 5 and let out two rooms from the eastern side of the building to defendant No.2 as monthly tenant and also let out portion of the building to Suruj Ali, Abdul Majid and Rustam Ali and the rest of the building was possessed by the plaintiffs, that Rustam Ali left the suit land making over possession to the plaintiffs, that the plaintiffs were evicted on January 30, 1984 in execution of the decree obtained by the defendant No.1 and on inquiry they came to know that defendant No.1 in collusion with the defendant No.2 created a bainanama dated January 22, 1972 alleged to have been executed by Narmada Kumari Ghose and on the basis thereof filed Other Class Suit No. 46 of 1976 and in the said suit Narmada Kumari Ghose was impleaded as defendant No.1 and beyond her knowledge vokalatnama and the written statements were filed and lateron a solenama was filed using the name of Narmada Kumari Ghose, that terms of the solenama was that Narmada Kumari Ghose would execute and register the deed within one month from the date of decree and in case of default the plaintiff would be at liberty to get the kabala executed and registered through Court. It was the case of the plaintiffs that the decree in Other Class Suit No. 46 of 1976 was obtained upon practicing fraud on the Court as at that time Narmada Kumari Ghose was not alive and the plaintiffs were in possession of the land in suit, that the decree obtained in Other Class Suit No. 46 of 1976 is illegal and fraudulent one.
